How to register

1.

Press Register now. It opens the registration page with our family code already in place.

2.

Fill in one form for your whole household: everyone who is coming, each person’s age, T-shirt size and any dietary needs. It takes about five minutes.

3.

We email you a private link right away. Keep that email. It is how you come back to change your registration and to report your payment.

The weekend at a glance

Fri, Jul 2

Hotel check-in, then a meet and greet in the evening at Clo and Aunt Do’s Place

Sat, Jul 3

Reunion activities and a family photo with every branch, then the banquet at the Dante Club

Sun, Jul 4

Family day and picnic at Frasier Gardens, and Fourth of July fireworks

Mon, Jul 5

Farewell breakfast at Tessy’s house, then safe travels home
